projects.title: MyNextBook — Hybrid Book Recommender
projects.description: End-to-end book recommendation system built from scratch: data pipeline (Google Books API → 1,300 books), cleaning, EDA, three ML models, offline evaluation, and a deployed Streamlit app.
projects.highlight: Hybrid TF-IDF + Sentence Transformer model achieves Hit Rate@10 of 0.290 and NDCG@10 of 0.141 — evaluated with leave-one-out across 300 test cases
projects.detail: Random baseline included to confirm genuine signal. Genre-aware re-ranking, author diversity cap, and Amazon purchase links built into the UI.

projects.title: Agentic Research Workflow
projects.description: Multi-agent system that generates a full research report on any topic through planning, tool-augmented search, writing, and editorial reflection
projects.highlight: Planner, researcher, writer, editor, and executor agents — each with a distinct role and model configuration
projects.detail: DeepLearning.AI Agentic AI course — graded lab, 40/40. Research tools: arXiv, Tavily, Wikipedia

projects.title: Roast — AI Startup Validator
projects.description: Multi-agent LLM system where 6 isolated models simulate synthetic user personas, run a structured debate with damage scores, and a RAG-powered investor panel scores startup viability across 5 dimensions
projects.highlight: Built solo overnight at a hackathon and deployed live — each agent runs a different model with its own API key
projects.detail: Concurrent agent execution, RAG investor panel, live debate scoring with Chart.js visualizations

projects.title: IEEE Fraud Detection
projects.description: End-to-end fraud detection pipeline on 590k transactions — from baseline failure analysis through LightGBM with SHAP explainability and business cost threshold tuning
projects.highlight: ROC-AUC 0.964, PR-AUC 0.777, 88.5% recall — cost-matrix threshold tuned for real business tradeoffs
projects.detail: Frequency encoding, 5-fold CV, SHAP feature importance, and a full baseline failure audit before modeling

projects.title: Gmail Graveyard
projects.description: Python-based Gmail cleanup tool—bulk deletes old emails, extracts unsubscribe links, and auto-categorizes your inbox
projects.highlight: Google OAuth2 auth, dry-run preview mode, and scheduled cleanup routines
projects.detail: CLI tool with configurable rules for protecting priority emails while purging the rest

projects.title: Yadetam — Iran Incident Monitor
projects.description: Interactive map aggregating bombing and airstrike incidents across Iran to help diaspora families track safety
projects.highlight: Live data from ACLED API with auto-refresh, bilingual Persian/English with RTL support
projects.detail: Color-coded markers by frequency, date filtering, and mobile-responsive design

projects.title: DS + MLE 4-Month Roadmap
projects.description: Interactive 16-week study planner with daily execution plans, LeetCode tracking, interview prep, and a living tree that grows a leaf for every completed task
projects.highlight: Day 86 of 98 — 254 leaves, 35 perfect days, 86% overall progress
projects.detail: Built with vanilla JavaScript. Tracks learning, coding, applications, and networking daily. Perfect days bloom flowers. Recovered tasks shine gold.
